text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan (Larangan

Penggunaan Jalan) (Bandaraya Kuala Lumpur) (No. 4) 2013.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan semua kenderaan di atas bahagian jalan sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama, sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual Kedua, melainkan dari arah yang ditentukan dalam ruang (2) Jadual

Pertama dilarang.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1) (2)

Jalan yang baginya larangan terpakai Arah yang ditentukan

Sebahagian Jalan Cenderawasih dari

persimpangannya dengan jalan tanpa

nama hingga ke persimpangannya

dengan Jalan Tembusu sebagaimana

yang ditandakan dalam peta dalam

Jadual Kedua

Kenderaan dari Jalan Cenderawasih

menghala ke Jalan Tembusu hendaklah

menggunakan jalan alternatif sebagaimana

yang ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual

Kedua

JADUAL KEDUA

Dibuat 10 September 2013

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/37/76 (B) PT. XV; PN(PU2)460/LXXII]

DATUK SERI HAJI AHMAD PHESAL BIN HAJI TALIB

Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD) (CITY OF KUALA LUMPUR)

(NO. 4) ORDER 2013

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 319 published on 29 Julai 2013, notice was given of the intention

to make an order under subsections 70(1) and (2) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333];

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur

against the making of such order;

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 70(1) of

the Act, the Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur, after consultation with the Director General

for Road Transport, and after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of Road)

(City of Kuala Lumpur) (No. 4) Order 2013.

Prohibition

2. The driving of all vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule, as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise than in the

directions specified in column (2) of the First Schedule is prohibited.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(1) (2)

Road to which the prohibition applies Direction specified

Part of Jalan Cenderawasih from its

junction with the unnamed road until

its junction with Jalan Tembusu as

demarcated on the map in the Second

Schedule

Vehicles from Jalan Cenderawasih

proceeding towards Jalan Tembusu shall

use the alternative road as shown on the

map in the Second Schedule

SECOND SCHEDULE

Made 10 September 2013

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/37/76 (B) PT. XV; PN(PU2)460/LXXII]

DATUK SERI HAJI AHMAD PHESAL BIN HAJI TALIB

Datuk Bandar Kuala Lumpur
